card.name: Start of a converted number in parentheses
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or first digit of a bracketed second-unit value that restates a quantity just given, such as (160°F) after 71°C or (8-12 mCi) after MBq. Also fires on 'next' before a time span.

modes.label: Unit conversion bracket
modes.description: The parenthesis or first digit of an equivalent value in another unit, right after a number and unit.
modes.example: burgers at a minimum of 71°C<< (>>160°F) and beef,

modes.label: Radioactivity dose in mCi
modes.description: The first digit of the mCi figure in parentheses after an MBq or GBq amount.

modes.label: Upcoming time span
modes.description: The word next or the space before a number of hours in a stated period.
modes.example: no plans to initiate a position in the<< next>> 72 hours.

card.writes: It suppresses approximate words like nearly and almost, so the model expects an exact figure rather than a hedged one.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a second, converted number is about to start, such as the Fahrenheit or mCi value after a metric one.
